notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact creature card in hand that can be cast using two mana or less.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast a nonartifact creature card from your hand by paying at most {2}.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Derevi from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Derevi by paying {3}.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat.
